query: Party order: 40 cupcakes, budget 120 dollars at 4 dollars each, half vanilla half strawberry, two nut allergies, plus 10 hazelnut.
response: I checked the menu: Vanilla Bean and Strawberry Shortcake both have plenty in stock, and hazelnut is not on the menu at all today. Three things to flag. That is 50 cupcakes in total, the 40 plus the 10 hazelnut, which at 4 dollars each comes to 200 dollars, well over your 120 dollar budget. Hazelnut would be unsafe with the nut allergies anyway, and our kitchen processes tree nuts, so we cannot guarantee a nut-free cupcake for anyone. And at 50 cupcakes this is a bulk order: those need at least 72 hours notice and a 50 percent deposit when you order. Within 120 dollars I can do 30 cupcakes, 15 Vanilla Bean and 15 Strawberry Shortcake, no hazelnut. Shall I start that, and when is the party?
